5428.title: Codex maintenance loses executable identity
5428.rootCauseOneLine: The provider discovers an absolute executable path but hardcodes codex when constructing the update plan passed to node-pty.

prReviews.verdict: Addresses verified root cause by static inspection
prReviews.topFinding: Carries executablePath into the existing helper; branch was not run.

5428.proposedFix: Use the resolved path for display and execution, preserving the null fallback and separate update argument. Open PR 5429 already closes the issue; no duplicate fix was pushed.
5428.caveats: The defect repeats in two clean trusted Linux checkouts. Native Windows startup and vendor-update completion remain unverified.
